preamble.summary: Job 31 closes Job's-summary-defense with the OATH OF INNOCENCE — a 14-fold 'IF I HAVE DONE X, LET Y HAPPEN' protestation covering all major-ethical-categories: lust (vv. 1–4), falsehood (vv. 5–8), adultery (vv. 9–12), justice-to-servants (vv. 13–15), care-of-the-poor (vv. 16–23), trust-in-wealth (vv. 24–28), enemy-rejoicing (vv. 29–32), and concealment-of-sin (vv. 33–34). Verse 13–15's 'did not he who made me in the womb make him?' is a foundational SAME-CREATOR ethic for human-equality.
preamble.notable_variants: 31:1 'I made a covenant with my eyes' visual-ethics covenant; 31:13–15 'did not he who made me make him?' — same-Creator equality ethic; 31:35 'oh that I had one to hear me!' final cry-for-witness.
preamble.structural_notes: MT Job 31 = LXX Job 31. 40 verses. Closes Job's SUMMARY-DEFENSE — the OATH OF INNOCENCE.

variant_notes: 'I have made a covenant with my eyes; how then could I gaze at a virgin?' tracks MT. COVENANT-WITH-MY-EYES. Visual-ethics covenant. Matthew 5:28's 'whoever looks at a woman with lustful intent has already committed adultery in his heart' Christologically-extends, internalizing the eye-discipline.
'What would be my portion from God above and my heritage from the Almighty on high?' tracks MT.
'Is not calamity for the unrighteous, and disaster for the workers of iniquity?' tracks MT.
'Does not he see my ways and number all my steps?' tracks MT.
'If I have walked with falsehood and my foot has hastened to deceit' tracks MT. The 'IF' protestation begins (continues through v. 34).
'Let me be weighed in a just balance, and let God know my integrity!' tracks MT.
'If my step has turned aside from the way and my heart has gone after my eyes, and if any spot has stuck to my hands' tracks MT.
'Then let me sow, and another eat, and let what grows for me be rooted out' tracks MT.
'If my heart has been enticed toward a woman, and I have lain in wait at my neighbor's door' tracks MT. ADULTERY-DENIAL.
'Then let my wife grind for another, and let others bow down on her' tracks MT.
'For that would be a heinous crime; that would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges' tracks MT.
'For that would be a fire that consumes as far as Abaddon, and it would burn to the root all my increase' tracks MT.

'If I have rejected the cause of my manservant or my maidservant, when they brought a complaint against me' tracks MT. JUST-TREATMENT-OF-SERVANTS — even-slaves get-due-process under Job's-household-justice.
'What then shall I do when God rises up? When he makes inquiry, what shall I answer him?' tracks MT.

'Did not he who made me in the womb make him? And did not one fashion us in the womb?' tracks MT. SAME-CREATOR EQUALITY ETHIC. One of the OT's strongest theological-grounds for human-equality and ANTI-SLAVERY ethics. Galatians 3:28 ('there is neither slave nor free … you are all one in Christ Jesus'), Philemon (Onesimus 'no longer as a bondservant but more than a bondservant, as a beloved brother') Christologically extend.
'If I have withheld anything that the poor desired, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail' tracks MT. CARE-FOR-POOR-AND-WIDOW direct-denial of Eliphaz's 22:9 charge.
'Or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it' tracks MT.
'For from my youth the fatherless grew up with me as with a father, and from my mother's womb I guided the widow' tracks MT.
'If I have seen anyone perish for lack of clothing, or the needy without covering' tracks MT.
'If his loins have not blessed me, and if he was not warmed with the fleece of my sheep' tracks MT.
'If I have raised my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate' tracks MT.
'Then let my shoulder blade fall from my shoulder, and let my arm be broken from its socket' tracks MT.
'For I was in terror of calamity from God, and I could not have faced his majesty' tracks MT.

'If I have made gold my trust or called fine gold my confidence' tracks MT. NOT-TRUSTED-IN-GOLD denial. 1 Tim 6:17 ('charge those who are rich … not to set their hopes on the uncertainty of riches') extends.
'If I have rejoiced because my wealth was abundant or because my hand had found much' tracks MT.
'If I have looked at the sun when it shone, or the moon moving in splendor' tracks MT.
'And my heart has been secretly enticed, and my mouth has kissed my hand' tracks MT. KISSING-THE-HAND — astrolatrous-gesture. Job denies sun-and-moon worship.
'This also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have been false to God above' tracks MT.

'If I have rejoiced at the ruin of him who hated me, or exulted when evil overtook him' tracks MT. NOT-REJOICING-OVER-ENEMY'S-RUIN. Proverbs 24:17 ('do not rejoice when your enemy falls') and Matt 5:44 ('love your enemies') extend.
'I have not let my mouth sin by asking for his life with a curse' tracks MT.
'If the men of my tent have not said: Who is there that has not been filled with his meat?' tracks MT.

'The sojourner has not lodged in the street; I have opened my doors to the traveler' tracks MT. HOSPITALITY-TO-SOJOURNER. Hebrews 13:2 ('do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for thereby some have entertained angels unawares') extends.
'If I have concealed my transgressions as Adam did, by hiding my iniquity in my bosom' tracks MT. ADAM-LIKE-HIDING — Genesis 3:8 echoed. Concealment-of-sin denied.
'Because I stood in great fear of the multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence and did not go out of doors' tracks MT.

'Oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Oh, that I had the indictment written by my adversary!' tracks MT. JOB'S-FINAL-CRY-FOR-WITNESS. The signature/sign (taw — last-Hebrew-letter — also-Job's-X-mark legal-sign) appended to-his-defense, awaiting-divine-response. Chapters 38–41 will be God's-answer.
'Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; I would bind it on me as a crown' tracks MT.
'I would give him an account of all my steps; like a prince I would approach him' tracks MT.
'If my land has cried out against me and its furrows have wept together' tracks MT.
'If I have eaten its yield without payment and made its owners breathe their last' tracks MT.

'Let thorns grow instead of wheat, and foul weeds instead of barley. The words of Job are ended' tracks MT. THE-WORDS-OF-JOB-ARE-ENDED. Editorial-colophon. Chapters 32–37 belong to Elihu (a new-character); chapters 38–42 to God-and-Job's-final-response.
